top_signals.title: Sapporo Breweries CSO on Tariffs, Iran War
top_signals.summary: Sapporo Breweries is shifting some production to the US from Canada due to 50% tariffs imposed on beer exports from the country, Chief Strategy Officer Rieko Shofu said. She spoke exclusively with Bloomberg's Shery Ahn on being impacted by tariffs, as well as the Iran war. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 'Ah! Rejected, yet again': How this 45-year-old turned his 'demoralizing' job search into a one-man show
top_signals.summary: After months of fruitlessly searching for a job, Tim Millard decided to turn his calamity into comedy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
